blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: segmentation — Memory organised into variable-size logical segments.
page fault — Access to a page not currently resident in RAM.

blocks.title: Paging
blocks.text: Virtual memory is split into fixed-size pages; RAM into frames.

blocks.title: Segmentation
blocks.text: Logical variable-size segments represent code, data or stack regions.

blocks.title: Virtual memory
blocks.text: The OS maps addresses and can move inactive pages to secondary storage.
